name: Yummy Yummy Monsters

start.dialog: I hungry! Want eat new things! You help Quina find yummy monsters? I eat them! Learn their powers! Then I share power with you! Good deal! Yes?
start.objective: Help Quina eat 5 different types of monsters to learn Blue Magic

progress.dialog: Still hungry! Need more yummy monsters! Different ones! More powers!
progress.objective: Find and defeat more monster types for Quina to consume

complete.dialog: So full! So many powers! You good helper! Here - I teach you Frog Drop! Very strong! Very funny! Make enemy go SPLAT!

party_comments.kade: They... eat monsters to learn magic? That's... different.
party_comments.twist: Can I try? Do I have to eat the whole thing?
party_comments.nix7: Bio-magical absorption. Inefficient but effective learning method.

hidden_outcome: If you bring Quina a 'Grand Dragon' to eat, they learn 'Limit Glove' and give you the 'Gourmet Fork' weapon
